card.headline: Al Ansar lose, but *top the group*.

highlight.text: Al Ansar are into the quarter-finals as Group A winners.

caption:
Al Ansar are into the AFC Challenge League quarter-finals as Group A winners, despite a 2-1 defeat to Ahal FC in Thimphu on Friday. ⚽

Wins over Paro FC and Al Ittihad Ahli of Aleppo had already put them top, and they stayed there.

Nejmeh's 3-1 win over Al Arabi wasn't enough in Group B: they finished second on six points, behind Homs Al Fidaa, and the West Zone's one best-runner-up place went to Al Ittihad Ahli of Aleppo.

How far can Al Ansar go? 🇱🇧

📸 AFC
